draft:
**Risk Framework**

Our approach to risk management is proactive and evidence-driven. On a 4-terabyte data migration for a retail energy provider, our discovery phase surfaced 3 critical data quality risks — encoding inconsistencies, orphaned relational records, and duplicated customer identifiers — before a single byte was moved to the target environment. Resolution of all three risks during a 6-week parallel-run period meant go-live proceeded without incident.

**Rollback as Standard**

Rollback is not an afterthought — it is a tested, rehearsed capability. During wave 2 of the same retail energy migration, we invoked our rollback procedure and reverted 230GB of transactional data in under 4 hours with zero data loss. The client's operations team was back at normal capacity the following morning.

**Continuous Risk Register**

A live risk register with weekly executive review will be maintained throughout this engagement. Risks are scored on probability × impact and tracked to closure, not just to mitigation.
